services.name: Key West Sunset Cruise
services.desc: 2 hours About Sunset Cruise in Key West! We are headed to the sandbar and beyond, our skipper will take us out for a private boat tour into the backcountry waters. Watch as we anchor over the sandbar, reaching deep enough for you to jump from just above waist high water and get some awesome pics with the sun setting behind you – it’s really something special. Itinerary 1. Start the trip 1.5hrs before the sunset at Marriott Beachside Marina 2. 30-minute boat ride to the sandbar 3. 1 hour on anchor at the sandbar watching the sunset 4. SUNSET 5. 30-minute boat ride back to the marina 2 hours • For up to 6 people

services.name: Night Kayak Tour
services.desc: A Unique Nighttime Adventure! Approximately 1hr20min Launch time is sunset dependent and varies throughout the year. About Night Kayak Key West is opening a whole new world of ocean exploration with a new unique nighttime adventure, Nightboarding™. Using I-Lumenate’s new NOCQUA Adventure Gear 2,000 lumens waterproof LED light bars, Night Kayak Key West is proud to be the exclusive tour operator in the Florida Keys! The unique oceanic experience launches every evening and interested parties can sign up now by calling Night Kayak Key West. Wildlife lovers, watersport enthusiasts and All ages • Single & Double kayaks • glass bottom • LED illuminated

services.name: Glow And Discover - Guided Night Kayak Eco Tour in Key West
services.desc: Discover the magic of Key West from a new perspective with our unforgettable Night Kayak Tour! What to Expect: Get ready for an exciting and serene kayaking adventure under the stars. Our Glow And Discover Night Kayak Tour will take you through the calm, crystal-clear waters of Key West, where you can explore the natural beauty of the area illuminated by the moonlight. You’ll glide past mangroves, through serene waterways, and possibly even spot nocturnal marine life shimmering in the water, creating a surreal and breathtaking experience. Highlights Include: Guided Experience: Knowledgeable tandem kayaks • glass bottom • LED illuminated

quotes.author: JUR at GNR
quotes.text: The trip itinerary and capt. were good, BUT THE BOAT???!!! The pix/vid you see online were taken early when the boat was new. Currently, the boat interior is worn, tattered and very weathered. It was so unrecognizable, that I thought I was at the wrong boat slip. I was shocked and VERY disappointed. It appears that the boat is docked outside, uncovered. I'm also shocked that no one is reviewing it this way. It is a good trip, but you're not getting the nice clean boat that you're seeing online and expecting. (my wife and adult daughter would not sit on the seats w/out a towel down)

quotes.author: Maciej Małolepszy
quotes.text: I had an incredible experience with Key West Boat Trips! Capitan Pawel was professional, friendly, and made sure everyone was comfortable and safe throughout the trip. The boat was well-maintained, and the views were absolutely stunning. We got to explore beautiful, secluded spots and enjoy the crystal-clear waters. The trip was both relaxing and exciting, with plenty of time for snorkeling and swimming. It truly exceeded my expectations, and I highly recommend Key West Boat Trips to anyone looking for an unforgettable day on the water!

quotes.author: Douglas Quaintance
quotes.text: Our party of four was looking for a great way to watch the sunset while in Key West. We selected Key West Boat Trips and experienced a gorgeous sun setting over the water. Our captain, Jason, was a pleasure, regaling us with his many adventures around the world, and amusing stories. We loved every minute of the trip, and highly recommend the company and Jason to anyone. Thanks for a great time Jason!

quotes.author: kandy donato
quotes.text: Had the best day with capt. Diane, we did a 3 hour sand bar trip, helped me from getting on the boat and then getting on the sandbar and my biggest fear trying to get back on with the tiny ladder, I did it and didn't feel like I was a dork..lol. She was great, we ever saw a pod of dolphins and she stopped and the came right up to the boat. Truly amazing experience, best day ever!

Amazing way to enjoy all of the keys So glad we found them. I’ll never book with another company. He took great care into getting us to some amazing places and made sure the day was the best it could be. Blew my expectations out of the water (pun intended). 12/10 stars, can’t wait to come back.

quotes.author: Kim Pereira
quotes.text: Took the 3 hour sandbar hopper today with Captain Diane and had the best time! She made sure we were safe but had fun. Took us to beautiful sandbars, didn't rush us and made sure we were having a blast. Would book again in a heartbeat! Totally recommend!
